name: stage counter climbs to a delivered banner
looks: A two-digit stage number and its label cut forward through a short production sequence while a row of dots beside it fills in to track progress, until the counter reaches its final stage and a diagonal banner sweeps across the frame announcing the work is done.
build: The stage-counter-dot-fill mechanic: a DOM number and label pair hard-cuts per step; a row of fixed dots advances its fill colour to match the step index; a rotated full-bleed bar wipes across on completion.
sound: A tick per dot filling, a rising pitch as the steps advance, a solid hit as the banner sweeps through.
prompt: Cut forward through a short numbered sequence of production stages, a stage number and label changing on each beat while a row of dots fills in beside it to track progress, then land on a diagonal banner sweeping across the frame to announce the work is delivered.
